item.title: 39 Tinder Profiles That Made People Laugh, Cringe, And Question Their Dating Life
item.description: Online dating is crazy and unpredictable. One swipe can lead to a former classmate, the next to a professional flirt. But regardless of whether you match with them or not, some people are much more memorable than the rest. They just have it. Showcasing pictures and bios that range from oddly charming to completely unhinged, this list has plenty of examples of what they look like in the wild. When it comes to first impressions, for better or worse, personality is queen.

item.title: Woman Kicks Husband’s Entitled Family Out After They Call Her Out For Not Having A Job
item.description: It started with generosity and trust, the kind that grows quietly over years. She supported her husband and even helped his extended family through financial struggles, never expecting repayment. But after becoming a mother and stepping away from work, the same family began questioning her worth and contribution. item.title: “Check My Privilege”: Woman Who Grew Up Wealthy Fails To Read The Room, Loses Friends In The Process
item.description: It is accurate to assume that people who grew up with money already have fewer problems than those who didn’t. So if you’re a rich kid who tries so hard to live like you share the same worries as everyone else, there’s a chance for it to blow up in your face. This is what a young woman experienced when she opened up about incurring debt from her own doing.

item.title: 39 People Share The Most Interesting Rabbit Holes They’ve Ever Been Down
item.description: For some people, their Roman Empire can be why flamingos are pink, why The Sopranos finale is the greatest of all time, or Google Street View. Indeed, some people have niche interests like collecting vintage board games, etymology, or "lost" TV show episodes you can no longer find anywhere. Folks in this thread have shared the topics that made them fall into proper rabbit holes and find out some really crazy facts.

item.title: “A Very Quick Shortcut To Personal Hell”: 57 Sobering Stories Of Ruined Lives Everyone Can Learn From
item.description: It sometimes happens in a single moment — a risky decision, a careless comment, or one choice made without thinking it through. For the people in these stories, that moment marked the start of a rapid downfall. From career-ending mistakes to personal decisions that spiraled out of control, these accounts reveal how quickly things can change. Scroll on to read the real-life stories people shared about the fastest ways they’ve seen someone derail their own life.

item.title: 67 True Stories That Sound So Bizarre Nobody Believed Them
item.description: When last did you witness a miracle? According to something called Littlewood's Law, we should all experience events with odds of one in a million at the rate of about one per month. From heart-warming encounters, to more creepy incidents, people are sharing unlikely things that have happened to them that no one else believes.

item.title: 41 Times People Changed How They View Their Relatives Due To A Secret Or Witnessing A Private Moment
item.description: All families have secrets of one kind or another — some are innocent like doing a good deed without letting anyone know, while others are quite sinister like infidelity or hiding financial problems. At the same time, some secrets are necessary to keep the family dynamics strong, others are just plain toxic. item.title: 55 Huge Things You May Not Have Known Came In Such Big Sizes
item.description: Humans are generally impressed by scale, be it a redwood so thick you could drive a car through it, or just a container of peanut butter large enough to last a lifetime. So if you want to see images that could be taken in some strange land where humans are very small, look no further.

item.title: People Are Rethinking Their Decision To Move After Finding These 39 Creepy Things In Their New Homes (New Pics)
55 Times People Spotted The Most Hilarious And Unhinged Bumper Stickers Ever (New Pics)
item.description: Many people spend hours in their cars each week. So it’s only natural to want to spice up your ride a bit. You might add some pillows to the backseat, a steering wheel cover to add some flair, and of course, some bumper stickers on the rear window. And if you’re looking for some inspiration for what stickers to place on your vehicle, here’s a list of clever and hilarious bumper stickers!
